اقترضوا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَضُوا (iqtaraḍū) /iq.ta.ra.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# اُقْتُرِضُوا (uqturiḍū) /uq.tu.ri.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# اِقْتَرِضُوا (iqtariḍū) /iq.ta.ri.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
